official: 東京都板橋区選挙長等の報酬及び費用弁償に関する条例の一部を改正する条例

sources.label: 議案の審査状況（令和8年第3回定例会）

name: 更正決定などの選挙会報酬を定める
summary: 選挙長などの報酬を定める条例に、当選人の更正決定や繰上補充に関する選挙会の報酬額を加えます。選挙長は選挙会ごとに6,000円、選挙立会人は5,000円とし、同日に複数の選挙会を開く場合は1選挙会分を上限とします。公布日に施行し、施行日以降に期日が公示または告示される選挙に適用します。
changes: 選挙長の報酬を選挙会ごとに6,000円、選挙立会人の報酬を5,000円と定める
同日に複数の該当する選挙会を開く場合、報酬を1選挙会分までとする
why: 当選人の更正決定や繰上補充に関する選挙会で、選挙長と選挙立会人の報酬額を定める必要があるためと、区は説明しています。

en.name: Sets pay for election meetings on corrected winner decisions and replacements
en.official: Ordinance Partially Amending the Itabashi City, Tokyo Ordinance on Remuneration and Expense Reimbursement for Election Meeting Chairs, etc.
en.summary: Adds pay for election meetings dealing with corrected decisions on who was elected or filling vacancies by advancing candidates to the ordinance that sets pay for election meeting officials. The election meeting chair will receive ¥6,000 for each meeting, and each election meeting observer will receive ¥5,000. If multiple election meetings are held on the same day, payment is capped at the amount for one meeting. The ordinance takes effect on the date it is promulgated and applies to elections whose date is announced or officially notified on or after the effective date.
changes: Sets the election meeting chair's pay at ¥6,000 per meeting and the election meeting observer's pay at ¥5,000
Caps pay at the amount for one meeting when multiple relevant election meetings are held on the same day
en.why: The ward says this is necessary to set pay for election meeting chairs and observers at meetings dealing with corrected decisions on who was elected or filling vacancies by advancing candidates.
